**Pixelmon Jenny** is a... Ah to hell with a proper description, buckle up dweebs the pixelmon modpack you've always dreamed of is finally here. That's right you read that name correctly and you saw those images, jump into your dreams of Pokémon X 2D Waifus.

---
# Features
- [🏝️] **Generation** - Powered by Oh The Biomes Weve Gone.
- [🧸] **Pokémon** - "I want to be the very best", who knows maybe you can! Enjoy a world filled with Pokémon.
- [👗] **Waifu's** - Enjoy a variety of different bed themed waifus, can't get them in real-life but 2D is wayyy better.
